channel.title: Tampa Bay News Monitor
channel.description: Press releases and breaking news, Tampa Bay

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Crystal River driver killed after hitting concrete pole: FHP
item.description: A Crystal River man was killed in a crash on Monday after he lost control of the vehicle he was driving, troopers said.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Judge tells Lindsay Clancy jury to keep deliberating after they can't get a unanimous decision
item.description: The jury in the criminal trial for Lindsay Clancy was sent back into deliberations after telling the judge they couldn't reach a unanimous decision.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Whistleblower raises concerns about untested USPS election technology
item.description: New USPS rules tied to Trump executive order could threaten timely delivery of mail ballots, whistleblower claims.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Interactive: Why America's biggest generation isn't giving up the big house
item.description: Baby boomers were supposed to downsize and free up family homes. Instead, many are staying put — or buying even bigger. Here's what that means for your homebuying chances.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Waymo begins welcoming public riders in Tampa
item.description: Waymo announced it will be welcoming public riders in Tampa starting Tuesday. The company said it will welcome the first public riders in Denver, San Diego, and Tampa starting Sept. 1.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Florida set to carry out 14th execution this year in the nation's busiest death chamber
item.description: A Florida man convicted of fatally shooting a 16-year-old girl who rejected his romantic advances and wounding two of her friends is set to be executed Tuesday in the first of three lethal injections scheduled this month in the state.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Trump meets with oil executives at White House in push to lower gas prices
item.description: President Donald Trump meets with oil executives Tuesday as the national gas average hits $4.10 a gallon.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Trump still teases seeking a third term. But he's now talking more about post-presidency life
item.description: President Donald Trump has frequently suggested he wants to seek a third term, posting about mounting another campaign, donning 2028 caps and discussing ways to make it happen.

item.title: [WATCHLIST: hurricane, tropical storm] [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Tropical Storm Edouard could strengthen before Texas-Louisiana landfall
item.description: A hurricane watch is in effect along parts of the Gulf Coast as Tropical Storm Edouard threatens heavy rain, flooding and strong winds.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Officers shoot woman accused of deadly Times Square stabbing attack
item.description: A woman was killed and another person injured after police say a knife-wielding attacker stabbed victims in Times Square before officers shot her.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Why some baby boomers are buying bigger homes, not downsizing
item.description: Baby boomers are holding onto larger homes longer, tightening housing inventory and making it harder for younger families to buy.

item.title: [WATCHLIST: hurricane, tropical storm] [FOX 13 Tampa Bay] Tropical Storm Edouard nears Texas with hurricane watches in effect
item.description: Tropical Storm Edouard remained a minimal tropical storm early Tuesday as it moved toward the Texas coast, with hurricane watches in effect for parts of Texas and Louisiana.
